player_prompt.intro:
Olina okuzina Tower of Hanoi ne diski {num_disks}.
Olina okuzitunda diski ku tower A okudda ku tower C.
Okuzitunda diski, andika tower esooka n'ey'oludda (kubangiriza, '[A C]').
Kumbagira nti osobola kuzitunda diski ey'oku kibira ky'atower pe, nti diski enkubwa teyaweebwa ku ndogo.
Ku kifo ky'omulundi, tuma ekizina kimu.

invalid_move.wrong_format: You did not respond with valid '[source] [target]'.
invalid_move.invalid_tower: Wateekawo ensibuko oba ekigo ky'olina okukwata nga si kituufu.
invalid_move.empty_tower: Wagezaako okusitula disiki okuva mu kigo ekitalina muntu.
invalid_move.same_tower: Wagezaako okutwala disiki mu kigo kye kimu.
invalid_move.larger_on_smaller: Wagezaako okuteeka disiki ennene ku disk entono.

game_action.moved: Oli eyongerwa diski {disk} ku {source} okudda ku {target}.

outcome.win: Congratulations! You solved the Tower of Hanoi puzzle.
outcome.turn_limit: Ekigero ky'okuyingiza kituuse. Oteekedde bulungi {pct}% ku disiki mu Tower C.
